remarks: Owner will consider Unfurnished or partially furnished for longer term lease.  A rare, unique "Nathaniel B. Weed" historic Antique Federal Colonial home in Darien, CT updated with modern conveniences. 3 BR, 2 BA townhouse- style unit where all levels are loaded with charm and character. Formal Living Room with woodstove, formal Dining Room, Updated Kitchen with walk-out to spacious deck. Primary Bedroom Suite with Athletic Whirlpool tub, custom walk-in closet/dressing area, hi ceilings & skylight. Close to Noroton Heights Train, beaches, shops, exercise, YMCA, Equinox, and Whole Foods. Pet may be considered. Unfurnished possible with 1+ year lease. Occupancy Negotiable
